# The UNO database

> Statistics of UNO games played by a group of friends since 2003 (about
> 1200 games, 130 players): scores per game, player statistics, comparisons
> and skill ratings. Points are the cards left in a player's hand at the
> end of a game; the winner gets 0, fewer points is better.

House rules differ between game types; see the rules pages before
interpreting points (e.g. in "Uno default" the scores are doubled when a
game ends with a black card).

## Pages

- [Home](https://uno.nubati.net/): overview, active players, recent sessions
- [Players](https://uno.nubati.net/players): games, wins, wins vs. chance, points per game
- [Sessions](https://uno.nubati.net/sessions): all sessions with records
- [Ratings](https://uno.nubati.net/ratings): points per game better than the table, pulled toward 0 for players with few games
- [Game types](https://uno.nubati.net/variants): house rules

## Data

- [All scores as CSV](https://uno.nubati.net/scores.csv): one row per player and game (date, location, game type, session, game, player, seat, points, won, black card)

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/arunpersaud/uno-db)
